title: lupinus littoralis var. layneae
intro: Lupinus littoralis var. layneae, commonly known as Beach Lupine, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. It is native to the coastal regions of the southwestern United States and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Beach Lupine include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, such as lupanine, sparteine, and kaempferol, that may contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.
